# Veralto to acquire In-Situ for $435 million, announces share buyback
WALTHAM, Mass. - Veralto Corporation (NYSE:VLTO) announced Tuesday it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire water monitoring solutions provider In-Situ for $435 million, while simultaneously authorizing a $750 million share repurchase program.

...

The acquisition, expected to close in the first quarter of 2026 subject to customary conditions, will expand Veralto’s presence in environmental water measurement and monitoring solutions. After tax benefits, the effective purchase price is approximately $422 million.

...

Veralto expects to achieve approximately $11 million in pre-tax run-rate cost synergies by the end of the third year following the transaction’s completion. The company anticipates the acquisition will deliver a double-digit return on invested capital by year five.

...

The acquisition will integrate In-Situ with Veralto’s existing OTT HydroMet business within its water analytics portfolio, creating what the company describes as opportunities to accelerate growth and drive operational efficiency.

...

Veralto, which generates annual sales exceeding $5 billion, provides water and product quality solutions globally with approximately 17,000 employees. The company plans to fund the In-Situ acquisition with cash on hand.
